只读取已提供 q 点的三维 Phonopy 模；未生成力常数、未插值 q 点、未: Only supplied three-dimensional Phonopy modes are read. No force constants, interpolated q points, inferred negative-q modes or Debye–Waller mesh are generated.
原胞与原子顺序由用户明确确认；散射长度是本次请求提供的实相干中子长度，不包括吸收: The user explicitly confirms the primitive cell and atom order. The real coherent neutron lengths supplied in this request exclude absorption, incoherent scattering, multiphonon scattering and X-ray form factors.
线权重按每原胞且 k′/k=1 归一为 fm²，能谱为单位面积 Gaussian: Integrated line weights are in fm² per primitive cell with k′/k=1. A unit-area Gaussian gives spectral density in fm²/meV; these are not instrument-calibrated experimental counts.
频率簇只是显示和求和：实际谱使用每条原始支各自的能量；接近的频率不等于数学精确简: Frequency clusters organize display and summation. The spectrum uses each original branch energy; nearby frequencies do not imply exact mathematical degeneracy.
ZXQD0DQXZ 单位必须明确声明: The unit of ZXQD0DQXZ must be declared explicitly
ZXQD0DQXZ 单位不受支持，请核对原始数值单位: Unsupported unit for ZXQD0DQXZ; check the units of the original numerical values
必须明确选择省略或提供 Debye–Waller 热位移张量: Explicitly choose to omit or supply Debye–Waller thermal displacement tensors
提供热张量须包含 mode、temperature、unit、tensors: Supplied thermal tensors require mode, temperature, unit and tensors
热张量温度与谱计算温度必须一致: The thermal-tensor temperature must match the spectrum temperature
相干中子散射长度 fm: Coherent neutron scattering length in fm
所选 q 点完整本征矢不是归一正交基，不能可靠计算子空间强度: The complete eigenvectors at the selected q point are not an orthonormal basis; subspace strengths cannot be calculated reliably
散射输入必须为 JSON 对象: Scattering input must be a JSON object
请明确确认配套原胞与本征矢的原子顺序: Explicitly confirm that the companion primitive cell and eigenvectors use the same atom order
本工具只接受明确的 phonopy-atom-phase 本征矢规范: This tool requires the explicit phonopy-atom-phase eigenvector convention
需要不超过64原子的完整配套原胞结构；不能用超胞替代原胞: A complete matching primitive cell with at most 64 atoms is required; a supercell cannot replace the primitive cell
原胞每个原子必须有明确质量和分数坐标: Every primitive-cell atom requires an explicit mass and fractional position
提供的 q 点或模点数量超过有界计算范围: The supplied q-point or mode count exceeds the supported calculation bounds
nqpoint 与实际提供 q 点数不一致: nqpoint does not match the number of supplied q points
通道须为 creation、annihilation 或 both: channel must be creation, annihilation or both
完整 Q 坐标须明确为原胞倒易分数或 Cartesian Å⁻¹: Full-Q coordinates must be primitive reciprocal fractions or Cartesian Å⁻¹
能量窗口终点必须大于起点: The energy-window maximum must exceed its minimum
已明确省略 Debye–Waller 衰减；即使 T=0 也不意味着真实热位移或: Debye–Waller attenuation is explicitly omitted. Even T=0 does not imply zero actual displacement or zero-point motion.
当前能量步长大于 sigma/2，峰形可能欠采样；解析窗口权重与数值积分分别报告: The current energy step exceeds sigma/2, so peaks may be undersampled. Analytical window weights and numerical integrals are reported separately.
部分所选 q 点没有动力学矩阵：已核对完整向量基，但不能据此认证原始力常数或频率: Some selected q points have no dynamical matrix. The complete vector basis is checked, but this does not certify the original force constants or frequency data.
序列化动力学矩阵校验使用 Rayleigh 本征残差；未把未知矩阵单位与频率转换: Serialized dynamical matrices are checked through Rayleigh eigenpair residuals. Unknown matrix units are not automatically equated with the frequency conversion factor.
明确标记的合成教学数据，不是真实材料计算或实验谱。: Explicitly labelled synthetic teaching data, not a real-material calculation or experimental spectrum.
单位不受支持，请核对原始数值单位: units are unsupported; check the original numerical units
频率单位声明冲突；不能仅改标签后计算谱权重: Frequency-unit declarations conflict; changing only the label cannot produce valid spectral weights
原始文件与确认的单位声明冲突：ZXQD0DQXZ: The original file conflicts with the confirmed unit declaration: ZXQD0DQXZ
省略 Debye–Waller 时不能同时附加未使用的热张量: Omitting Debye–Waller attenuation cannot include unused thermal tensors
热位移张量必须在 Cartesian 坐标中对称: Thermal displacement tensors must be symmetric in Cartesian coordinates
热位移张量必须半正定，不能具有负方差: Thermal displacement tensors must be positive semidefinite, with no negative variance
热位移投影产生负方差: The thermal-displacement projection produced a negative variance
物种散射长度须完整且只包含当前原胞物种: Species scattering lengths must cover exactly the species in the current primitive cell
计算散射需要所选 q 点全部 3N 条频率与完整复本征矢: Scattering requires all 3N frequencies and complete complex eigenvectors at the selected q point

q 点必须为对象: Each q point must be an object
完整 Q 与所选原始 q 和整数 G 不匹配；不采用最近邻或自动折叠: Full Q does not match the selected original q and integer G; nearest-neighbor matching and automatic folding are not applied
必须提供整数 G 或明确坐标的完整 Q: Provide integer G or full Q with explicit coordinates
negativeQIndex 只用于双通道，不能附加未使用参数: negativeQIndex applies only to both channels; unused parameters cannot be supplied

只输入 G 时坐标约定须为原胞倒易分数: When only G is supplied, the coordinate convention must be primitive reciprocal fractions
指定湮灭 q 点与 Q+q 整数条件不匹配: The selected annihilation q point does not satisfy the integer Q+q condition
双通道需要唯一的实际负 Q 对应模；请提供或明确选择 negativeQInde: Both channels require a unique supplied mode matching negative Q; supply it or select negativeQIndex explicitly. Time reversal is not inferred
输入为非正或虚频，不计算一声子谱权重: Nonpositive or imaginary input frequency; no one-phonon spectral weight is calculated
